This '''empire''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that was established by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vilia Calimondra]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Calimondra had seven children, and each one claimed to be the true heir to her holdings, so in order to determine which one would become her benificiary, she instigated a contest&mdash;the ''[[Charge Matrica]]''&mdash;in [[1066 BBY]], challenging her children to expand her territories. However, the siblings declared war on each other and fought amongst themselves. Eventually, only Calimondra's son [[Chagras]] was left, and he became the heir to Calimondra's empire. Chagras established his own state, the [[Chagras Hegemony]], but Calimondra retained control of most of her holdings. In [[1040 BBY]], Chagras was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and Calimondra began a [[Second Charge Matrica|second ''Charge Matrica'']], to find herself a new heir from among her grandchildren.
